answer: Latency Ledge Admission. Each identity must keep a client-side packet-timing profile whose inter-arrival gaps stay on a basalt-flat baseline; agents whose variance spikes past a dune-like threshold are queued until the slope flattens. Attacker cost: renting enough stable, low-jitter egress capacity per identity, since cheap churn or bursty relays trip the ledge and stall admission.
